auth.heroText: Upload a signed contract, confirm what ConTrack extracts, and make sure the right person hears about a deadline before it slips.

features.extract: Parties, dates and obligations pulled from your documents — reviewed by your team before they count.

features.audit: Role-based access, and an audit trail on every change.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in with your work email.
login.subtitleAdminOnly: Use the account your administrator created for you.
login.forgotText: Password reset by email arrives together with email notifications. Until then, ask your ConTrack administrator to set a new password for you.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
login.adminOnly: No account yet? Ask your ConTrack administrator to invite you — accounts are created by admins only.

signup.subtitle: It takes less than a minute.

users.title: Users & roles
users.subtitle: Create accounts, assign roles and scope, and deactivate people who've left.
